description.value: Quality Foods is a BC-based independent supermarket chain with a full-service store in Port Alberni on Vancouver Island. The store carries a wide range of fresh produce, bakery, deli, and household goods, making it a strong resupply stop for cyclists touring the island. An online shop and weekly flyer are available, and the store accepts cash, credit, and debit.
